title: SrDetection: Self-Referential Leakage Detection for Code Large Language Models
authors_zh: Shuaimin Li, Liyang Fan, Zeyang Li, Zhuoyue Wan, Yufang Lin, Shiwen Ni, Feiteng Fang, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Yuanfeng Song, Kun Jing, Chen Jason Zhang, Min Yang

one_line: controlled leakage testbed and self-referential detection code
以语义等价代码变体为内部参照，无阈值检测 Code LLM 的逐题预训练泄漏。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code-benchmark scores can reflect memorization of pre-training examples rather than generalization, but existing leakage detectors need hidden training corpora, temporal assumptions, or externally calibrated thresholds. That makes sample-level auditing impractical for proprietary Code LLMs.

SrDetection turns each benchmark program into its own reference set: it creates semantics-preserving variants and asks whether the original is unusually predictable. It is an audit method and controlled testbed for code-data leakage, not a new code-generation training recipe.

Its intended decision is item-level: flag a program only when its behavior differs from matched rewrites, so a maintainer can investigate a specific benchmark item rather than infer leakage from aggregate performance.

代码基准的高分可能来自预训练时见过题目，而非真正泛化；现有泄漏检测又常要求拿到训练语料、依赖发布时间假设，或用外部参考集校准阈值，因此难以审计闭源 Code LLM 的单个样本。

SrDetection 把每个基准程序自身变成参照：生成语义等价变体，再检查原程序是否异常容易被模型预测。它提供代码数据泄漏的审计方法与受控测试床，而不是新的代码生成训练配方。

其目标是逐题决策：仅当原程序与匹配改写的行为不同才标记，使维护者能调查具体基准项，而非由总体性能推断泄漏。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SrDetection is a threshold-free, self-referential membership detector: a leaked code item should be easier than its functionality-preserving rewrites. The evaluation surface is one original program plus generated variants; gray-box detection compares perplexities, while black-box detection compares completion-to-reference n-gram overlap. The within-set extremum rule is the verifier. No separately downloadable benchmark dataset is identified; the repository releases code and data for the method.

The method therefore avoids inferring a universal likelihood cutoff from an unrelated corpus. It instead asks a matched counterfactual question for every audited item.

SrDetection 是无阈值的自指式成员推断检测器：若代码项被训练见过，原始写法应比保持功能不变的改写版本更容易预测。评测对象是一段原程序及其生成变体；灰盒比较困惑度，黑盒比较补全与真实后缀的 n-gram 重合度，集合内极值规则即为 verifier。论文未单列可下载 benchmark 数据集；仓库公开方法代码和相关数据。

因此它避免了从无关语料推断通用似然阈值的做法。 它改为对每个被审计项提出一个与之匹配的反事实问题。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Start with a benchmark code sample and generate functionality-preserving edits such as variable or function renaming and test-case transformations.
  2. In gray-box access, score the original and every variant by perplexity; flag leakage only when the original has the minimum score. In black-box access, complete prefixes and compute n-gram overlap with each true suffix; flag only when the original has the maximum overlap.
  3. Build ground truth by continued pre-training open Code LLMs on selected samples while holding out matched samples, then evaluate F1 against this controlled membership label. The acceptance rule is relative within the generated set, not a global threshold. Verify repository versions, transformations, training mix, epochs, and model access; generation budget and transformation prompts are not fully reported.

1. 从一段基准代码出发，生成保持功能不变的编辑版本，例如变量或函数改名、测试用例变换。
  2. 灰盒场景计算原样本与全部变体的困惑度，只有原样本最低才判为泄漏；黑盒场景从前缀生成补全，计算与各自真实后缀的 n-gram 重合度，只有原样本最高才判为泄漏。
  3. 作者对开放 Code LLM 在选定样本上继续预训练，并保留匹配样本作为未见集合，以受控成员标签评估 F1。判定只比较生成集合内部，不设全局阈值。复现应核验仓库版本、变换、训练混合、epoch 和模型访问；论文未完整披露生成预算与变换提示词。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Self-referential comparison detects controlled code leakage more reliably than threshold-calibrated baselines. In the continued-pretraining testbed, matched Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B models are compared with PPL, Lowercase, Zlib, Min-K variants, and DC-PDD.

At one epoch, gray-box macro-F1 is 74.76 and 69.99 for SrDetection, versus the next best 52.44 and 65.91; at five epochs, black-box F1 reaches 81.85 and 78.51 (Tables 1–2). This supports the controlled code setting, not direct proof of proprietary pre-training membership or robustness to every edit.

自指式比较比阈值校准基线更可靠地检测受控代码泄漏。作者在继续预训练测试床中，以相同 epoch 的 Qwen2.5-7B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B，对比 PPL、Lowercase、Zlib、Min-K 系列和 DC-PDD。

在 1 个 epoch，SrDetection 的灰盒 macro-F1 分别为 74.76、69.99，次优方法为 52.44、65.91；5 个 epoch 时，黑盒 F1 达到 81.85、78.51（表 1–2）。这支持其在受控代码场景的检测能力，不能直接证明真实闭源预训练成员关系，也未覆盖所有语义等价改写。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior detectors use corpus overlap, timestamps, or likelihood thresholds calibrated with external data. SrDetection instead compares a sample only with its own semantics-preserving variants, under both logits and output-only access. Its novelty is the threshold-free within-sample decision and controlled training testbed, not perplexity or code augmentation alone. Reuse requires checking semantic preservation and the target API's access mode.

This shifts calibration from a population-level reference to a matched local counterfactual. It also makes the decision interpretable as a comparison among representations of one program.

既有检测器使用语料重合、时间戳，或经外部数据校准的似然阈值。SrDetection 改为仅将一个样本与自身的语义等价变体比较，并同时适用于 logits 可得和只可见输出的场景。其新意是无阈值的集合内判决和受控训练测试床，而非困惑度或代码改写本身。复用前应检查变换确实保留语义，以及目标 API 支持哪种访问模式。

这把校准从总体参考集转为与原项匹配的局部反事实。 判决也因此可解释为同一程序不同表示之间的比较。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The detector assumes that generated variants preserve functionality and are sufficiently diverse; weak transformations weaken the contrastive signal. Reuse should execute or otherwise validate variants before interpreting a flag.

The authors note that subtle output differences may be masked for very large or instruction-tuned black-box models, and they test code only. A non-flag does not establish absence of leakage; audit additional signals and modalities before making release claims.

The controlled continued-pretraining labels are useful ground truth but do not reproduce every unknown web-scale pretraining mixture. They also do not show that a detected item is the only cause of an observed benchmark score.

该检测假定生成变体既保持功能又足够多样；若变换质量差，对比信号会变弱。复用时应先执行或以其他方式验证变体，再解释泄漏标记。

作者指出，极大模型或指令微调黑盒模型的细微输出差异可能被掩盖，且实验仅覆盖代码。未被标记并不等于不存在泄漏；发布结论前应审计额外信号和其他模态。受控继续预训练标签虽提供真值，但不能复现所有未知的网络规模预训练混合，也不能证明被检出的单项是某个基准分数的唯一直接主要根本原因。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a code-benchmark maintainer with programs and model access, generate validated refactorings, run the matching gray- or black-box scorer, and output item-level leakage flags before publishing a leaderboard. Check F1 on a controlled held-out mix and manually inspect flagged examples.

Use it when training data are unavailable. Do not apply the extremum rule unchanged to natural language, non-equivalent edits, or APIs lacking completions or logits; first build a domain-specific variant validator.

The success check is not merely a flag count: execute variants, retain the scoring traces, and sample flagged and unflagged items for manual review.

代码基准维护者若已有程序和模型访问权限，可生成经验证的重构版本，运行相应的灰盒或黑盒评分器，在发布榜单前输出逐题泄漏标记；再在受控留出混合上检查 F1，并人工复查被标记示例。

当训练数据不可得时可采用该方法。不要把极值规则原样用于自然语言、非等价编辑，或无法取得补全或 logits 的 API；应先建立领域专用的变体验证器。

成功检查不只是统计标记数：应执行变体、保存评分轨迹，并人工抽查被标记与未标记项目。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Target: item-level code leakage, not generic code quality.
  2. Lever: compare an original program with semantics-preserving variants; the relative extremum is the detector.
  3. Artifact: the official repository releases code and data; a separate dataset specification is not reported.
  4. Evidence: gray-box F1 reaches 74.76/69.99 at one epoch; black-box F1 reaches 81.85/78.51 at five epochs.
  5. Reuse: validate variants first; black-box sensitivity on very large instruction-tuned models remains a risk. Preserve prompts and score traces, then manually audit both flagged and unflagged examples.

1. 定位：审计逐题代码泄漏，不是一般代码质量。
  2. 抓手：比较原程序与语义等价变体，相对极值就是检测器。
  3. Artifact：官方仓库公开代码和数据，论文未给出独立数据集说明。
  4. 证据：1 个 epoch 的灰盒 F1 为 74.76/69.99；5 个 epoch 的黑盒 F1 为 81.85/78.51。
  5. 复用：先验证变体；极大指令微调模型的黑盒敏感性仍有风险。保留提示与评分轨迹，并人工审计标记和未标记例子。
